title: Bonnie | Hooded Cardigan That Works Year-Round
bodyHtml:
This is the cardigan you'll reach for on cool mornings, layered over everything, and then again on those mild autumn days when you want just enough warmth without the bulk. It's the piece that adapts to your day—and to the weather—without fuss. Throw it on over a tee or slip it on solo, and you've got an effortless layer that doesn't cling or add bulk to your frame. Perfect from September right through to late autumn, this hooded cardigan is genuinely hard to find.

Why you'll love it

  • The perfect layer when the chill kicks in—slip it over a top, blouse or light sweater for warmth without weighing you down
  • Soft and skimming, it wraps you in comfort from sunrise to bedtime without ever feeling tight or restrictive
  • Warm enough to wear solo on mild days, cool enough to layer when it's crisp—no need for a heavier jacket
  • Works with everything: jeans, trousers, dresses, skirts—open or closed, you're ready in seconds
  • The hood adds a practical touch on breezy days, plus a bit of casual cool to any outfit
  • Designed for our 30th Anniversary Collection with extremely limited stock—no restocking once it's gone
  • Women are loving it: 4.8 out of 5 stars from over 50,000 of us

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
